title: Let admins mark orders paid
description: Adds POST /api/orders/:id/pay so an admin can mark a pending order paid when the bank transfer arrives. Includes tests and a README entry.

comments.issue: The 'refuses customers' test sends no token, so it gets 401 for being signed out and never reaches the admin check; with `not.toBe(200)` it would still pass if customers could mark orders paid. It should send the customer's token and expect 403.
